channel.title: Sonneblom Digitaal: South African Printables
channel.description: South African Printables from Sonneblom Digitaal

item.title: South African Traditional Games
item.description: The games our parents and grandparents played! A printable book of 9 traditional South African games from all of the country's communities, with rules, safety tips and a printable Morabaraba board. Two full editions are included: one in Afrikaans and one in English.

item.title: Our Family Story: Heritage Journal
item.description: Keep your family's story for the next generation. A fill-in heritage journal for South African families, whether you still live at home or now live far away. Two full editions are included: Afrikaans ("Ons Familie Storie") and English ("Our Family Story").

item.title: Afrikaans Party Games
item.description: Lekker speletjies for your next braai, birthday or kuier! A South African party games pack written in Afrikaans.

item.title: Afrikaans Activity Book for Kids
item.description: Keep Afrikaans alive at home! "Kom Ontdek Suid-Afrika" is a 20-page activity book for kids aged 4 to 10, written fully in Afrikaans and filled with South African animals, places and food.

item.title: Afrikaans ABC and 123
item.description: Teach your little one the Afrikaans alphabet and numbers! 40 tracing worksheets for children aged 3 to 6, written in Afrikaans.

item.title: Afrikaans Christmas Activity Book
item.description: Geseënde Kersfees! A 20-page Christmas activity book for kids aged 4 to 10, written fully in Afrikaans, with a South African summer Christmas twist (strand, braai and gammie included!).

item.title: Afrikaans Birthday Party Pack
item.description: Throw an Afrikaans birthday party! Everything you need to print, in Afrikaans.

item.title: Afrikaans Word Search
item.description: 20 word search puzzles in Afrikaans, one theme per page, with all the solutions at the back. Lovely for Ouma and Oupa, Afrikaans learners and anyone who misses the taal.
